english.meaning: ends a sentence to state a point firmly, as in 'it has to be so'
english.note: Often follows 先得 or 都要. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Then you have to buy the hot-and-sour soup ingredients there first.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉嗰度有料買酸辣湯啲嘢先得𠿪。
